# Techtonic Innovations — LLM-Readable Site Summary
# https://www.techtonicinnovations.com
# Last updated: 2026-09-21

## Company Overview
Techtonic Innovations is an enterprise technology company headquartered in Reston, Virginia, in the Washington, DC metro area. We specialize in AI solution engineering, AI agents and automation, elite tech talent placement, and modern web platform / custom software development.

## What We Do

### 1. AI Development Services
https://www.techtonicinnovations.com/ai-development-services
We design and deploy custom artificial intelligence systems: large language model (LLM) integration, RAG pipelines, intelligent automation, predictive analytics, computer vision, and natural language processing, architected for each client's specific business context.

### 2. AI Automation Agency
https://www.techtonicinnovations.com/ai-automation-agency
AI-powered workflow automation and AI chatbot development that removes manual, repetitive, and judgment-heavy work from a team's day-to-day operations.

### 3. AI Agent Development
https://www.techtonicinnovations.com/ai-agent-development
Custom AI agents that plan multi-step work, call tools and APIs, reason over a company's own data via RAG, and complete tasks end-to-end with human-in-the-loop guardrails.

### 4. Custom Software Development
https://www.techtonicinnovations.com/custom-software-development
Full-cycle custom software product development from concept to launch, with AI capabilities integrated where they add real value.

### 5. Web Application Development
https://www.techtonicinnovations.com/web-application-development
Modern, high-performance web applications and digital platforms built with React, Next.js, and a cloud-native stack, optimized for speed, accessibility, SEO, and conversion.

### 6. Hire AI Engineers
https://www.techtonicinnovations.com/hire-ai-engineers
Contract and permanent placement of vetted AI engineers, machine learning specialists, and data scientists, or a forward-deployed AI pod: a small embedded team that works inside the client's stack.

### 7. IT Staff Augmentation
https://www.techtonicinnovations.com/it-staff-augmentation
Pre-vetted senior engineers, data scientists, and DevOps specialists who embed directly into an existing team and process.

### 8. AI Consulting (Small Business)
https://www.techtonicinnovations.com/ai-consulting
AI consulting scoped to small and mid-size business budgets and timelines — practical MVPs and assessments, not enterprise-scale engagements.

### 9. AI Readiness Audit
https://www.techtonicinnovations.com/ai-readiness-audit
A paid two-to-four-week audit of workflows, data, systems, and risk. Deliverable: a written AI-use roadmap and a phased build estimate. Fixed price, scoped on a free call.

### 10. AI Discovery Sprint
https://www.techtonicinnovations.com/ai-discovery-sprint
A fixed-price four-to-six-week proof-of-concept sprint on one use case. Deliverables: a working prototype on the client's real data, an evaluation report, and a production roadmap.

### 11. AI Security Audit
https://www.techtonicinnovations.com/ai-security-audit
AI code, security, and cost audit for LLM systems: LLM red teaming, prompt-injection testing, evaluation harnesses, and a model API cost review.

### 12. Managed AI Services
https://www.techtonicinnovations.com/managed-ai-services
A monthly retainer to operate AI systems after launch: monitoring, scheduled evaluations, model and prompt updates, and API cost control. Tiers (Monitor, Operate, Embedded) are scoped on a free call.

### 13. Shopify Development
https://www.techtonicinnovations.com/shopify-development
Shopify store builds, custom themes, migrations, headless storefronts, custom apps and integrations, plus AI add-ons for search, catalog content, and support.

### 14. Mobile App Development
https://www.techtonicinnovations.com/mobile-app-development
Cross-platform iOS and Android apps with Flutter and React Native, built alongside the web application and backend by one team.

### 15. AI Development Company in Virginia
https://www.techtonicinnovations.com/ai-development-company-virginia
Local information for Northern Virginia / Washington, DC metro businesses; the same services are available nationwide.

## Case Studies
https://www.techtonicinnovations.com/case-studies
Each case study is written from the project's repository and live site; results list only verifiable facts.

Our products (designed, built, and operated by Techtonic Innovations LLC):
- Co-Help (https://co-help.com) — Electron desktop AI assistant for Windows and macOS: live transcription, a parallel race across AI providers via a managed Cloud Run API, local-first storage. https://www.techtonicinnovations.com/case-studies/co-help
- Justice Genie (https://justicegenie.help) — FastAPI + RAG legal-information app for self-represented litigants: answers designed to be grounded in the user's documents and cited public law, abstains when unsure, mock-hearing practice mode. https://www.techtonicinnovations.com/case-studies/justice-genie
- NexGen QA (https://qa-automation.com) — multi-tenant AI testing platform with 35+ modules, a bring-your-own-key GitHub Actions runner, and an SSRF-hardened public website audit tool. https://www.techtonicinnovations.com/case-studies/nexgen-qa

Client projects:
- Bagram Events (https://www.bagram.us) — Next.js website for an Afghan cultural events organizer in the Washington, DC area, with ticket links and a Resend-powered contact form. https://www.techtonicinnovations.com/case-studies/bagram-events
- Design by Masuma (https://designbymasuma.com) — photography-led site for a floral and event design studio with an Express API, live consultation calendar, and emailed inquiries. https://www.techtonicinnovations.com/case-studies/design-by-masuma

## How to Engage
Contact us for AI consulting, AI agent or automation development, talent placement, web development projects, or custom software builds. We start every engagement with a free discovery call to understand your specific needs before proposing a solution. Pricing depends on scope, team size, and engagement model — we do not publish flat rates because projects vary too widely, but we always provide a transparent estimate after the discovery call.

## Frequently Asked Questions (Q&A)

Q: What does Techtonic Innovations do?
A: Techtonic Innovations is an enterprise technology company that delivers AI solution engineering, AI agents and automation, elite tech talent placement, and modern web/software development. We help organizations design, build, and scale AI-powered software.

Q: What AI and machine learning services do you offer?
A: Custom AI systems including LLM integrations, RAG pipelines, AI agents, NLP, computer vision, predictive analytics, and intelligent automation — architected for each client's business context.

Q: Where is Techtonic Innovations located?
A: Headquartered in Reston, Virginia, in the Washington, DC metro area. We serve enterprise, SaaS, healthcare, finance, government, and e-commerce clients across the US and remotely worldwide.

Q: How do you place engineers and tech talent?
A: We connect organizations with rigorously vetted AI engineers, data scientists, ML specialists, full-stack developers, and technical leaders via contract staff augmentation and permanent placement.

Q: What's the difference between an AI agent and a chatbot or automation?
A: A chatbot answers questions; a traditional automation follows a fixed sequence of steps; an AI agent is given a goal, decides which tools or APIs to call, adapts to intermediate results, and carries a multi-step task through to completion.

Q: What technologies and frameworks do you work with?
A: OpenAI and Anthropic Claude, AWS, Azure, Google Cloud, React, Next.js, TypeScript, Node.js, Python, FastAPI, PyTorch, TensorFlow, Hugging Face, PostgreSQL, vector databases, Docker, Kubernetes, and Terraform.

Q: How long does a typical project take?
A: Agile two-week sprints; we deliver in weeks, not quarters. Many web platforms and AI MVPs launch within 6–12 weeks depending on scope.

Q: How much does it cost to work with Techtonic Innovations?
A: Pricing depends on scope, team size, and engagement model (fixed-scope project, dedicated team, or staff augmentation). We provide a transparent estimate after a free discovery call.

Q: How do we get started?
A: Use the contact form or email info@techtonicinnovations.com. We respond within one business day and begin with a free discovery call.
